Name: Dialogue Box Redesign
Author: gzhynko
Description:
A simple SMAPI mod that makes the dialogue box lighter. It removes the wood-styled background, adding a gradient one instead. It also allows to move the portrait to the left of the text and hide the speaker's name or the friendship jewel. See the screenshots for a preview.


[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip its folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*]Compatible with SMAPI 3.13 and higher (the latest version is recommended).
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5 and higher.
[*][i]Incompatible [/i]with the mobile version.
[/list]

Dialogue Box Redesign is [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/tree/master/DialogueBoxRedesign]open-source[/url]﻿ and is licensed under the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/blob/master/LICENSE]0BSD License[/url]﻿.
